based_on: Today's signals: Hitachi mining-equipment orders, heavier factory workload and overtime, and uncertainty over how long the cycle will last
question: Kung ang overtime ay sabay na blessing—dahil may orders, income, at job security—at burden—dahil kinukuha nito ang oras, lakas, at buhay sa labas ng trabaho, paano mo malalaman kung ang sipag mo ay faithful stewardship pa rin o kung ang trabaho na ang unti-unting nagiging sentro ng buhay mo?

verses.text: Better is an handful with quietness, than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit.
And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
